# reverse-requests

Provider: Grok Build. Version: Constructed from verified Grok 1.0.3 request contract.

Origin: constructed example.

Covers: Permissions, plan revision, questions keyed by text, selected outcomes; responses require direction and request correlation.

Pairing: No paired live capture.

Known gaps: Expected output is a research proposal, not current Nano output or an executable parser oracle.

Scrubbing: private prose, argument strings, paths, ids, model keys, and opaque data use neutral placeholders. Captured arrays keep at most three members. Hashes describe scrubbed input, not private source bytes. Only minimal excerpts are retained.
